title: tRNA charged fraction over the cell cycle (all seeds)
interpretation: Mean fraction of charged tRNA (averaged across tRNA species) for all 4 seeds. Stays high (~0.92-0.98), consistent with amino-acid-replete exponential growth; mild dips track transient ribosome/charging dynamics. x-axis in minutes.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert/matplotlib on the mac mini
